I own this bean plot, so I will put some effort into it, but money is tight this season. I will use seed I kept from last year and spread some manure from my animals, plus a little NPK fertilizer left over from my maize — maybe enough for about 15 kg nitrogen on this field. Last season pod borers ruined half the crop, so I will buy insecticide to spray twice. My family will do most of the work, but I will hire two young men for three days at harvest when the pods are ready, and I depend only on the rains.
